fixture_policy: External read-only source workbooks. Repository stores only logical IDs, filenames, SHA-256 values, and privacy-safe aggregate expectations.

tag_catalog.multi_sheet: Workbook contains multiple sheets that must all be discovered.
tag_catalog.mixed_types: One logical field contains different storage types.
tag_catalog.formula_cells: Workbook contains formulas and cached values.
tag_catalog.negative_amounts: Cash fields contain negative, zero, and positive values.
tag_catalog.duplicate_columns: A sheet contains repeated header names.
tag_catalog.wps_style_anomaly: A mainstream XLSX reader rejects a WPS style definition.
tag_catalog.incorrect_used_range: Declared worksheet dimension is smaller than actual populated cells.
tag_catalog.field_name_drift: Equivalent candidate fields use different raw names across years.
tag_catalog.text_dates: A date-like field is stored as text.
tag_catalog.cross_year_data: The group spans at least two fiscal years.
